Brown hares have a number of physical adaptations that enable them to survive in open countryside.
They have exceptionally large ears that move independently
the hares’ large golden eyes give them 360° vision
a higher volume of blood in their bodies, and this allows for superior speed and stamina
their legs are longer than those of a rabbit, enabling hares to run more like a dog
